_readme: Optional. Copy to kit.local.json (git-ignored) and fill what applies; every key has a default. Read by dev-kit/scripts/kitconfig.ps1 (PowerShell scripts), devtools.py and guard.ps1. Paths: forward slashes work on every OS (Windows: C:/src). See skills/dev-kit/reference/configuration.md.

localEnv._readme: Optional local pre-staging envs (local-env skill). Secrets: <kit>/localenv.local/<env>.env (dotenv), never here.

db.clone: <script: start a DB server on {+5432} with a copy of the test data>

driveParent: <Google Drive folder or shared-drive id for tester guides (reports.type gdocs)>

tracker._readme: type: clickup (default) | github | gitlab | jira | none. github/gitlab need repo; jira needs env JIRA_BASE_URL/JIRA_EMAIL/JIRA_API_TOKEN. statuses maps logical names to your board's names (a list = first is set, all match).
tracker.list: <default list id / Jira project key for new tasks>
tracker.owner: <optional: assignee of new tasks; empty = your OS full name matched to a tracker member>

reports._readme: type: gdocs (Google Docs + Drive via the gws CLI; default when gws is installed) | markdown (report.md in the QA run folder, carried by the tracker comment)

build._readme: mavenOffline: Maven runs with -o (offline) when ~/.m2/repository exists (default true); false = always online.

gate._readme: Memory gate (gate.ps1). keepFreeGB (default 15% of RAM, min 6; env CLAUDE_GATE_KEEP_FREE_GB wins) = RAM every build leaves free. startHeapGB = first heap for a project with no build history (then learned); heapMinGB = the floor.

repos.name: web
repos.linkFrom: <a worktree whose node_modules can be linked (optional)>

deploys.target: <env deployed by hand onto a host>
<env deployed by hand, no way to check>
<test phones of an app repo (the emulator lane APK)>

linkFromByTarget.<other target branch>: <a checkout of that branch with its own install (e.g. git worktree add --detach + frozen-lockfile install)>

linkPaths: <git-ignored file or folder every worktree needs, e.g. api/local-credentials.json or app/android/local.properties>

bugfixMandate: <the task owner's own words asking the coordinator to fix QA-raised bugs, verbatim>
